verdict.rationale: Firebase CLI (firebase-tools) and MCP server support headless project creation, Firestore data/rules management, and Auth user import/export, which an agent could script; Security Rules and emulator suite further support scripted policy/schema setup. However, there is no single documented command or workflow for provisioning a full backend (schema+auth+policies) in one headless script — evidence is spread across separate tools without an end-to-end scripted example. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end headless script/example combining schema (Firestore rules/structure), auth setup, and policy deployment in one CLI/agent-driven flow, and independent hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow.
